command:
set -u
ERR=/var/jb/var/mobile/WindowServer.err
touch /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macws_runtime_diagnostics
echo "SENTINEL_ARMED rc=$?"
START=$(wc -l < "$ERR" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
launchctl kickstart -k user/501/UIKitApplication:com.macwsguide.windowserver 2>&1 || true
sleep 12
echo "=== new gen CGXSYNTH-INSTALL ==="
tail -n +$((START+1)) "$ERR" | grep -nE "CGXSYNTH-INSTALL|LOADER-OBS|CTOR-CANARY" | head -10
echo "=== WS pid ==="
ps aux | awk '/Resources\/WindowServer/ && !/awk/' | head -3
